answer.evidence: The backrest (rows 8-14, dark blue, L about 44-67) is a face-on vertical panel with only a 1-row light rim at row 9. Below it, rows 15-18 are lighter purple (L about 97, with a highlight on row 16 at x=4) and read as a seat top seen from above. Row 19 is a darker edge line and row 20 is the dark outline or eave shadow. Under that, rows 21-28 show the footrests and wheel bases as the front support, about 8 rows. The seat top is short at 4 rows, and the backrest has no visible top surface of its own.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small, sparse prop of about one tile. Its 12 distinct colours and 12 colours per tile match the simple Beodeul props (hedge 11 colours and 10 per tile, bench 14, lamp 14). The larger stall and well reach 38-40 colours, but they are much bigger pieces. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, so there are no dead fills. Only 6% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline leans navy or purple and follows the frame, fabric and wheel materials instead of being a uniform black sticker line. The seat and backrest, wheel rims and hubs, and the frame each carry about 3-4 value steps with some highlight dots. That is a bit less than Beodeul's 5-6 on large materials, but it is in line with the small props at this scale. It would sit next to the hedge and bench without looking flatter or more sticker-like.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small piece, about 14x20 source pixels. The measured facts are not the problem. It has 12 colours per tile against 10 for the hedge and 0 to 20 for the other references. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and only 6% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline leans blue or purple and is not a black sticker line. The weakness is in the shading. The 12 colours are spread across several materials: fabric seat and back, metal frame, wheels and footrests. That leaves roughly 3-4 steps per material, where Beodeul uses 5-6 (the bench wood, the hedge greens and the well stone all have deeper ramps). By eye the seat and backrest read as mostly one dark mass with little grain or per-part highlighting, and the wheels are simple rings. It is clean and tinted, but thinner and flatter than the references, so it fails the bar, though not by much.
